messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: data.table as reactive object
parts:
data.table unfortunately isn't a good fit with Shiny's reactivity. You can read more about why, and a couple of workarounds, here: https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/issues/1017

But you'll probably have a better experience with Shiny if you use dplyr instead, as it uses a more functional programming approach that integrates naturally with reactivity.
